# Cramio

> Cramio is a focused study space: notes, PDFs, AI study chat, quizzes, and flashcards in one place. Tagline: "Cram less. Learn more."

Study app for students. Android-first: the native Android app ships through a restricted release channel (no public APK downloads yet), and everyone else uses the web app in the browser on iPhone, iPad, or desktop with the same account.

## Links

- [Cramio landing page](https://cramio.site/): marketing site with features, how it works, and FAQ
- [Cramio web app](https://app.cramio.site/): the product itself, usable in any browser

## What Cramio does

- Keeps notes, PDFs, AI study chat, quizzes, and flashcards together in one focused space
- Built Android-first; web app works everywhere with the same study space and account
- Some content can be available offline on-device; AI chat, sign-in, and cloud sync need internet

## FAQ

- Can I use Cramio on the web? Yes, if you're not on Android, the web app is the way in: same study space, same account, any browser.
- Does Cramio work offline? Some on-device content may; AI chat, sign-in, and cloud sync need a connection.
- Is the Android app publicly downloadable? Not yet: it ships through a restricted release channel; the web app is open to everyone.
- What can I study with Cramio? Your notes and PDFs, topic questions, quizzes, and flashcards; you pick what and when.
